title: Need for integration of representation learning with complex reasoning
description: Major progress in artificial intelligence requires systems that combine representation learning with complex reasoning. New paradigms are needed to replace rule-based manipulation of symbolic expressions with operations on large vectors.
canonical_description: representation learning needs integration with complex reasoning and symbolic manipulation

evidence.anchor: new paradigms are needed to replace rule-based manipulation
evidence.quote: Although deep learning and simple reasoning have been used for speech and handwriting recognition for a long time, new paradigms are needed to replace rule-based manipulation of symbolic expressions by operations on large vectors <sup>101</sup>.
